NVIDIA (NVDA) vs Apple (AAPL): on the same formula, their operating margins are 27.4 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — NVDA: $215.9B · AAPL: $478.8B
• Revenue growth — NVDA: +65.5% · AAPL: +15.1%
• Operating margin — NVDA: 60.4% · AAPL: 33.0%
• Net margin — NVDA: 55.6% · AAPL: 27.6%
• Free cash flow margin — NVDA: 44.8% · AAPL: 28.4%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — NVDA: 68.3% · AAPL: 5.0%

Different fiscal years: NVDA Jan 25, 2026 · AAPL Sep 26, 2026. The periods are not identical.
